Fish soup

Time: time
Servings: servings
Source: Koníííík
Tags: tested, savory, soup, main-course, medium-effort, fish, gluten-free

Ingredients

  • 400 g mixture of frozen sea food (scallops, shrimp, squid)
  • 600 g frozen salmon and alaska pollock
  • 250 g white onion (one big)
  • 1 red bell pepper
  • 1 green bell pepper
  • 1 baby bok choy
  • 2 carrots
  • 1 bulb of garlic
  • 1 tbl sp mild oil
  • 800 g diced tomatoes (fresh or canned)
  • 0.5 l chicken broth or seafood broth; I used lobster stock
  • 2 dl heavy cream
  • salt and herbs to taste – I used oregano, basil, thyme, 4 bay leaves

Instructions

  1. Preheat oil on medium heat. Add peppers and onions and cook until tender. About 3-5 minutes.
  2. Add carrots and garlic. Cook for an additional 2 minutes.
  3. Add in tomatoes, tomato sauce, broth and seasonings. Simmer covered on low 30 minutes.
  4. Add the frozen fish. Boil covered for 5 minutes.
  5. Add sea food, and baby bok choy. Boil covered for an additional 3-5 minutes.
  6. Pour in the cream, stir it in.
    Garnish with fresh parsley, serve with freshly toasted garlic bread.
